title: LangGraph Template with Cloudflare D1 Checkpoints and MCP Tools
summary: Collier King builds a reusable LangGraph app template with D1 checkpoints and a remote MCP server.
learn: A LangGraph checkpoint package for Cloudflare D1 stores short-term chat state in a serverless database.
After a Docker restart or refresh, the app pulls the conversation state back from D1.
The graph merges a local search tool with remote tools from an MCP server.
AI Gateway tracks inference requests, token use and prompts, and the logs can be downloaded.
A graph registry lets one FastAPI backend serve multiple graphs behind a Next.js front end.
